summary: Quiet residential kerb with cars parked, but homes sit 14-20 m away on both sides.
reasons: Gentle slope near the east end

drivers.seclusion: A scrubby vacant block on the north side gives some gap, but mapped dwellings sit 14-20 m away on the north and houses face it from the south.

drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; a busier road at the east end.
drivers.convention: No signs; vehicles and a caravan are parked on the street and at the east corner.

flags: Dwellings 14-20 m away on both sides
